race.comment: ORCHID SKY (9) returns from a four-month spell. Tackled stronger races than this throughout the last prep and wasn't up to the task. Recent Ballarat jump-out winner who has found a far more realistic assignment to launch this prep. KISS ME IN PARIS (8) was ridden colder last start over this distance at Echuca and turned in a much better performance at the second run back, closing powerfully to be beaten just 1.8 lengths. Very fit and should prove tough to hold out. GODDESS STORM (7) debuted at $41.00 over today's journey at Mornington recently and didn't finish all that far away. Key runner with D Yendall replacing a 3kgs claimer. LANGE NELLE (5) returned from a 19-month lay-off in a $65k maiden at Warrnambool and found that task beyond her. Subsequently won a 1000m a Hamilton jump-out so she can improve sharply on that first-up run. MAMZELLE RAINE (6) isn't racing well but she isn't alone there. Can sneak into the frame out of the inside stall.
